description: This file provides database interaction functions for a mobile service website backend, including schema initialization, data seeding, and CRUD operations for bookings, services, device brands, models, and site content, primarily interfacing with a Supabase/PostgreSQL database.

methods.name: str _table(name: str)
methods.description: Constructs the full table name, including schema if configured, for use in database queries.

methods.name: Any _sb()
methods.description: Provides access to the cached Supabase client instance.

methods.name: Any _sb_exec(query)
methods.description: Executes a Supabase query, normalizes the response, and raises errors if encountered.

methods.name: None _ensure_catalog_seeded()
methods.description: Performs a best-effort seeding of device brands, models, and repair services in the database if they do not already exist.

methods.name: None init_schema()
methods.description: Initializes the database schema and performs catalog seeding; serves as an entry point for setting up the database layer.

methods.name: list[dict] list_services()
methods.description: Returns a list of available repair services for display on the website.

methods.name: list[dict] list_booking_services()
methods.description: Provides a list of repair services for use during the booking process.

methods.name: list[dict] list_brands()
methods.description: Fetches a list of device brands available for booking.

methods.name: list[dict] list_models_for_brand(brand: str)
methods.description: Retrieves models associated with a specific device brand.

methods.name: dict get_site_content(keys: list[str])
methods.description: Fetches key-value pairs for site content entries based on a list of keys.

methods.name: int create_customer_request(name: str, phone: str, email: str, mobile_model: str, problem: str)
methods.description: Inserts a new customer service request into the database, returning the new record's ID.

methods.name: int create_booking(name: str, phone: str, pincode: str)
methods.description: Creates a new booking record and returns its ID.

methods.name: dict|None update_booking_device_selection( booking_id: int, brand: str | None, model: str | None, service: str | None )
methods.description: Updates device and service selection fields for an existing booking.

methods.name: list[dict] list_bookings(limit: int = 200)
methods.description: Retrieves recent bookings, with an optional limit for display in admin panels.

methods.name: dict|None get_booking_by_id(booking_id: int)
methods.description: Fetches booking details by ID for tracking and confirmation purposes.

methods.name: dict|None get_latest_booking_by_phone(phone: str)
methods.description: Retrieves the most recent booking associated with a given phone number.

methods.name: dict|None update_booking_status(booking_id: int, status: str, notes: str | None = None)
methods.description: Updates the status and notes of an existing booking.

methods.name: bool verify_admin_credentials(username: str, password: str)
methods.description: Checks admin login credentials against environment variables to permit access.

ctags.name: create_booking
ctags.pattern: /^def create_booking(name: str, phone: str, pincode: str) -> int:$/

ctags.name: create_customer_request
ctags.pattern: /^def create_customer_request(name: str, phone: str, email: str, mobile_model: str, problem: str) /
ctags.signature: (name: str, phone: str, email: str, mobile_model: str, problem: str)

ctags.name: update_booking_device_selection
ctags.signature: ( booking_id: int, brand: str | None, model: str | None, service: str | None )

ctags.name: update_booking_status
ctags.pattern: /^def update_booking_status(booking_id: int, status: str, notes: str | None = None) -> dict | None/
ctags.signature: (booking_id: int, status: str, notes: str | None = None)
